ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. reported its daily share buyback activity for August 21, 2026, repurchasing 91,757 equity shares at an average price of ₹305.94, bringing the cumulative total to 518,668 shares under the ongoing program. This buyback reduces the number of outstanding shares, which typically supports earnings per share and signals management's confidence, with no apparent red flags presented in this routine regulatory disclosure.
